newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU mergers and takeovers - (UPDATED JULY 3).
newsitem.headline: EU mergers and takeovers - (UPDATED JULY 3).

text.p: The following are additions and deletions to the list of takeovers, mergers and joint ventures being reviewed by the European Commission under the European Union's merger regulation (*). The Commission has a month to clear or start a detailed, four-month probe after a deal has been filed.
-- German company Siemens AG's purchase of all of the industrial activities of Swiss energy and industrial firm Elektrowatt AG of Zuerich (Notified June 24)
-- Rhone-Poulenc's and Merck & Co's proposed Merial animal health joint venture (Cleared July 3)

-- Proposed Prevoyance RE reinsurance joint venture between Mederic Prevoyance, Urrpimmec, the insurance body for the French metal, mechanical and electric industries, CRI Prevoyance and Muenchener RE (Cleared July 3)

-- Purchase by Germany's Lear Corporation GmbH, offshoot of the U.S. firm of the same name and producer of car seats and interior components, of Keiper Car Seating GmbH, a producer of complete seat systems in just-in-time sequence (Notified 19 June)
-- Siemens and Thomson-CSF proposal to put their air traffic management activities into a joint venture called Airsys ATM SAS (Notified June 17)

-- Proposal by Southern Energy Holding mbH, which belongs to Southern Co, Viag AG and Preussen Elektra to acquire joint control of Bewag, an utility servicing electricity customers in Berlin (Notified June 11)
-- Proposal by Cable & Wireless and A.P. Moeller's Maersk Data A/S to create a joint venture called Cable & Wireless Nautec Ltd to provide communications for container ships (Notified June 3)
-- Proposal by Compagnie Generale d'Entreprises Automobiles and Energie-Versorgung Schwaben AG to acquire joint control of German transport firm DEG-Verkehrs GmbH (Notified June 2)

-- Deutsche Bank's property unit Deutsche Immobilien Anlagegesellschaft and VEBA's VEBA Immobilien AG proposed joint control of Deutschbau, a company which builds houses for German federal employees (Notified May 22)
-- Proposed merger between Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc (Full probe opened June 20)
-- Proposed Nordic soft drinks joint venture of Coca-Cola and Carlsberg A/S of Denmark. (Full probe opened May 2).
-- Boeing Co proposed acquisition of McDonnell Douglas. (Full probe opened March 19).

(*) Commission has exclusive EU competence in corporate concentrations involving firms with a combined global turnover of 5.0 billion ecus and EU turnover of 250 million ecus each. It has the power to block, or force changes to, deals which create or strengthen dominant positions in the EU whether or not the companies involved are European.
